input.quote: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
input.rationale: § 12.4 is a one-sided restrictive covenant on Customer only: it is an express no-hire ("hire, or employ"), runs for 24 months after the term, covers any Vendor employee rather than only personnel directly involved in the Services, and has no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out (indeed "regardless of how the employee applies" deliberately defeats such carve-outs). That fails every fallback element and sits in walk-away territory. It also contradicts § 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges Customer has made "no ... no-hire commitment". We therefore took the preferred position and removed the restriction on Customer with a single in-place edit, leaving § 12.3 consistent; a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to involved personnel with the customary carve-outs and no no-hire remains available as a fallback.

proposal.summary: Remove the one-sided 24-month no-hire/non-solicit on Customer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have removed the one-sided 24-month no-hire and non-solicit on Customer, which also contradicts § 12.3's confirmation that we have made no no-hire commitment; our position is no non-solicitation restriction on Customer, though we could accept a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.

ops.oldText: Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
ops.newText: Customer is subject to no restriction on soliciting, hiring, or employing any Vendor employee.
